title: 😂 Every Cult Begins With a Leader Who Confused Charisma for Calling.
paragraphs: 😂 Every Cult Begins With a Leader Who Confused Charisma for Calling.
Some people think they’ve been anointed… when really, they’ve just been good at public speaking and smoke machines.
🎬 This is your reminder that confidence isn’t always a calling — and applause doesn’t always mean approval.
✨ “Sometimes the sermon is just stand-up comedy with a lighting budget.”

📖 Bible Verse:
“For such men are false apostles, deceitful workmen, disguising themselves as apostles of Christ.”
— 2 Corinthians 11:13 (ESV)
🔥 Moral: Charisma can fill a room — but truth can change a life.
